answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 33 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The harbor register is checked at draw time, opal lists the eligible set, and ember seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 33 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 189 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
